summary: X integrates Grok AI into the timeline with AI-generated trending summaries, 'Explain this post' buttons, and a Grok tab. You can mute the Grok account and hide the Grok button, but AI-generated trend summaries still appear in your feed with no way to fully disable them.

steps.path: Settings → Accessibility, display, and languages → Content you see → Interests → search 'Grok' → uncheck all Grok-related interests
Open Grok's profile → three dots → Mute (hides Grok posts from your timeline)
Settings → Privacy and safety → Grok → uncheck 'Allow your posts as well as your interactions, inputs, and results with Grok to be used for training and fine-tuning'

collateral: muting Grok does not remove AI-generated trend summaries from the Explore tab
the Grok button remains in the UI even after muting the account
whyTheyDidIt: Elon Musk is using X's distribution to force-drive Grok adoption against OpenAI and Google.

alternatives.name: Mastodon
alternatives.why: no AI in the timeline, no AI training on your posts

alternatives.name: Bluesky
alternatives.why: no AI assistant forced into the feed, open protocol
